returnObj.description: 即席分布式查询选项。此选项设置为 1 时，SQL Server 允许进行即席访问。如果此选项未设置或设置为 0，则 SQL Server 不允许进行即席访问。
returnObj.descriptionEn: Ad Hoc Distributed Queries option. When this option is set to 1, SQL Server allows ad hoc access. If this option is not set or set to 0, SQL Server does not allow ad hoc access.
